tried: dreizinnen.com tour 569 (no group rule on the page)
group_min.note: No group minimum is published for this day hike; none is known for waymarked paths in South Tyrol or Veneto.

age_band.note: Board figures 8.8 km and 550 m (effort_km 14.3): over the 8-9 ceiling of 9 km and 500 m on climb, inside the 10-12 ceiling. A wide path with no exposure, so the climb is the only limit. The out-and-back to Rifugio Lavaredo and Forcella Lavaredo is shorter and suits younger walkers.

conflicts.note: The trip plan used 6; not a rule (migration rule 7.2).

suitability.kid_note: The full loop is 8.8 km with 550 m of climbing at 2,200-2,450 m. Rifugio Lavaredo is an easy first goal, and the north-face view at Forcella Lavaredo comes after about an hour.

carrier_ok.note: The board rates it easy and recommends the first section even to inexperienced hikers; no hands-on sections or ladders are named.

stroller.note: A mountain path above 2,100 m with a climb to Forcella Lavaredo; the board names no pushchair use.

conflicts.note: Trail reports give 9.5-10.5 km for the standard loop and up to 17.7 km with detours.
Trail reports give 400-480 m.

surface.note: Wide gravel and stony path, from the trail research; the board page does not describe the surface.

exposure.note: No exposure is named on the board page; trail reports describe a wide path.

v.note: The loop runs between 2,169 m and 2,451 m; thunderstorms build on July afternoons, so start early.

hazards.note: Altitudes from the board page; the storm pattern is from the trip's timing research.

food.note: Rifugio Lavaredo, Rifugio Locatelli and Lange Alpe are on or beside the loop.

v.note: Toll road to Rifugio Auronzo, online booking only (12 h ticket, car 40 EUR); season late May to late October, weather permitting
Shuttle line 444 from Dobbiaco to Rifugio Auronzo

access_season.note: auronzo.info gives late May to late October; dreizinnen.com says usually June to October.

age_band.note: Short (about 4 km, 150-210 m) but the viewpoint is an unfenced rocky promontory with narrow eroded sections; the age is set by the drop, not the distance.

suitability.kid_note: Short, but it ends on an unfenced rocky spur with a drop on three sides. Hold small hands, and turn back before the via ferrata section of path 117.

carrier_ok.note: Narrow, eroded sections and an exposed final overlook.

stroller.note: Narrow rocky path.

wheelchair.note: Narrow rocky path with steps of rock.

distance_km.note: Out and back from Rifugio Auronzo, from a dated trail report cited in the trip research.

conflicts.note: Another report gives 3.2 km.
OSM path 117 from Rifugio Auronzo to the approximate viewpoint pin, 2.16 km one way, doubled; the pin is approximate.
Another report gives 210 m.

adult_time_min.note: 30-40 min each way plus time at the spur.

v.where: the final promontory and some narrow eroded sections

v.note: Unfenced drop-off at the viewpoint; path 117 beyond it is a via ferrata (CAI EEA).
Same toll road and Rifugio Auronzo car park as the Tre Cime loop; online booking only

suitability.kid_note: Path 215 is easy for the first hour, then crosses ladders and cabled ledges above drops. Not for anyone uneasy with heights. Swimming and paddling in the lake are not allowed.

stroller.note: A family hiking blog calls the path unsuitable for pushchairs (search result).

source_grade.note: cai_scale E as tagged on the OSM relation of CAI path 215 (operator CAI); the CAI section's own page was not found.

conflicts.note: Lowest trail-report figure.

conflicts.note: One report gives 114 m to the lake one way: the traverse is mostly level.

adult_time_min.note: 4.5-6 h with time at the lake, from the trip research.

v.where: ladders, boards and cable-protected ledges on the second half of path 215

food.note: Rifugio Vandelli on the shore, cash only.

suitability.kid_note: The open-air WWI museum is a short walk from the chairlift's top station: trenches, gun posts and tunnels. Keep small children close at trench edges.

carrier_ok.note: A short walk on mountain paths; no ladders on the museum circuit.

stroller.note: Trench paths and steps.
